boundaries.statement: Source context expands text stored in the chunk table; it does not re-parse the source file to recover exact original text.
The UI has not been exercised in a browser against the real backend.
A saved HTTP result does not establish model quality, unobserved worker effects, or unexecuted race/timeout paths.
The full 23-step F01 remains outside this matrix run and belongs to T16.

task_pool_alignment.T15: T15 records cross-task HTTP behavior, side effects, evidence, and gaps; it does not take over fixes owned by T08-T14.

ownership_note: owner_task and owner identify the responsible task and task-owner role. The task pool deliberately has no named assignees prefilled; each matching task currently has no individual assignee, so no person's name is implied.
